Associate Professor in Statistics at the [Department of Statistics](https://stat.lu.se) at [Lund University](https://lu.se), Sweden, where I am also director of doctoral studies.

My research is in computational and spatial statistics: Gaussian random fields and SPDE-based models, including Gaussian processes on metric graphs and non-Gaussian latent models; Bayesian computation; and sparse high-dimensional regression. Much of this work is developed together with open-source [software](software.qmd). I also work on applications, in particular climate-sensitive infectious diseases.

**Research interests**

- Gaussian random fields, SPDEs and Gaussian processes on metric graphs
- Non-Gaussian latent variable models
- Bayesian computation and MCMC
- Sparse and high-dimensional regression (SLOPE)
- Spatial confounding and forecast evaluation
- Statistical modelling of climate-sensitive infectious diseases
